title: One brown, please
theme: ordering at a Hà Nội café (đá, nâu, đường, ít); an order in three turns; Hà Nội's coffee
intro: Four words for the café counter (ice, brown, sugar, a little) and your first full order in three turns: ask for a coffee, answer the waiter, hear the bill. In Hà Nội, milk coffee has its own name.

feature.title: Brown, black and egg
feature.dek: Why Hà Nội orders its milk coffee as brown, why it comes with condensed milk, and the milk shortage that gave the city egg coffee.
feature.intro: Coffee came to Vietnam with the French, and Vietnam made it its own: dark-roast robusta dripped slowly through a little metal filter, the phin, onto sweetened condensed milk, then poured over ice. In Hà Nội today a café can be three plastic stools on a pavement or a shop with a menu of a dozen coffees.

beats.text: Why condensed milk? Iced milk coffee is believed to be an adaptation of the French café au lait. Fresh milk was scarce and spoiled quickly in the heat, so tins of sweetened condensed milk took its place, and dark-roast robusta, more bitter than arabica, balanced the sweetness. Ice, for the tropical heat, was the last change.

In Hà Nội cafés milk coffee is often ordered by its colour: nâu, brown. Nâu đá is iced, nâu nóng is hot, and black coffee is đen, black: đen đá, đen nóng. In the South the same glass is cà phê sữa đá, milk coffee with ice.

Egg coffee, cà phê trứng, was created in the late 1940s by Nguyễn Văn Giảng of Cà Phê Giảng in Hà Nội, his family says, when milk was scarce: egg yolks whipped with condensed milk and sugar into a thick foam over the coffee. It comes in a small cup, sometimes standing in a bowl of warm water to keep it warm, with a teaspoon for the foam.

New coffees keep coming. Yogurt coffee, cà phê sữa chua, was created in Hà Nội in 2012 by Phạm Duy Trí, and coconut coffee, cà phê cốt dừa, was made popular by the Hà Nội chain Cộng Cà Phê. Salt coffee, cà phê muối, was created in Huế in 2010.

words.hook: Ice cubes clink into your glass: "dah!", the voice jumping up: đá, ice.
words.tip: đ is a full d, as in "day"; a is long, as in "father"; sắc: rise.
words.note: đá: the glass full of cubes. trà đá, iced tea; nâu đá, iced milk coffee. đá also means stone.

contrast.en: skin; leather (in Hà Nội d sounds like z: "za")

words.en: brown; in a Hà Nội café, coffee with milk
words.hook: The condensed milk swirls up and the black coffee turns brown: a quick "nuh-oo", short and kept level: nâu, brown.
words.tip: The same nuh-oo as nấu (issue 12), but level: no rise.
words.note: nâu: the layered brown glass. nâu đá, iced milk coffee; nâu nóng, hot. In the South it is cà phê sữa đá.
words.remember: nâu stays level: the brown milk coffee you drink. nấu rises: the cooking Bà does at the stove (issue 12).

words.hook: You stir the sugar in slowly: one long, low syllable, ư gliding into ơ, then ng, sinking: đường, sugar.
words.tip: đ as in "day"; ươ glides from ư (oo with spread lips) to ơ ("uh"), then ng; huyền: low and falling gently.
words.note: đường: the sugar bowl. ít đường, a little sugar; không đường, no sugar. The same word is a road: đường phố, a street.

words.hook: Just a tiny bit: a short, sharp "eet!", the voice rising: ít, a little.
words.tip: i is "ee" as in "see", cut short; the final t is held, not released; sắc: rise.
words.note: ít: the teaspoon tipping a few grains. ít đường, a little sugar; ít đá, not much ice.

grammar.title: Cho anh ... Ordering at the counter
grammar.text: Order with cho (give) plus the word for yourself, then what you want: Cho anh một nâu đá. One iced brown, please (to someone younger). Change it with a describing word after it: ít đường, a little sugar; không đường, no sugar; ít đá, not much ice.

examples.en: One iced milk coffee, please. (to someone younger)
One iced tea, please. (to someone older)

combos.note: The pavement drink of Hà Nội.

combos.en: I want a hot milk coffee. (to a friend)

lines.vi: Trà đá ở đây ba nghìn thôi.

check.ask: Your friend says iced tea here is only 3,000. You are pleasantly surprised. Say your answer aloud first, then pick it.
check.note: Rẻ quá: so cheap. thôi: only. Nóng quá: so hot; Hết đá rồi: the ice is all gone.

situations.say: One milk coffee, please! (to the young waiter)
accept: Em ơi, cho anh một nâu.
Cho anh một cà phê nâu.
situations.ask: The order, turn 1 of 3. The young waiter comes over. Order a milk coffee, the Hà Nội way.
situations.note: In Hà Nội milk coffee is nâu, brown.

situations.vi: Anh uống nóng hay đá ạ?
situations.ask: Turn 2 of 3. It is a hot afternoon and the waiter checks. What do you answer?
situations.note: hay: or. Đá em nhé: iced, please.

situations.vi: Của anh hết ba mươi nghìn ạ.
situations.ask: Turn 3 of 3. You ask for the bill. What do you pay?
situations.note: Của anh hết ...: yours comes to. ba mươi nghìn is 30.000; ba nghìn would be 3.000.

situations.vi: Trà đá ba nghìn một cốc anh ạ.
situations.ask: How much is a glass of iced tea?
situations.note: One number before nghìn: ba nghìn, 3.000. Many stalls now charge năm nghìn, 5.000.

situations.vi: Hai cốc trà đá, hết sáu nghìn ạ.
situations.ask: You and a friend had an iced tea each. What do you pay?
situations.note: hết here: in total. In Hết đá rồi it means all gone.

situations.vi: Cà phê trứng bốn mươi nghìn anh nhé.

options: They have run out of ice.

challenge.title: Street challenge
challenge.text: Order a coffee the Hà Nội way today: Cho anh (or em) một nâu đá, or đen đá, ít đường. Try trà đá at a pavement stall and check the price. Bonus: find egg coffee and eat the foam with the teaspoon before you drink.
